КУБОХОД — original project assets

All raster backgrounds, textures, skin previews, and app icons in this folder are original procedural artwork created for this project with scripts/create-assets.py.
No downloaded photographs, stock illustrations, external icon sets, or remote fonts are used.
You may use, modify, and distribute these project assets together with the game or separately.
The interface uses the system sans-serif font installed on the player's device.
Audio effects and optional music are synthesized locally using Web Audio.
UI icons and stars under ui/ were generated for this project with OpenAI's built-in ImageGen. The production prompt is recorded in ui/provenance.json. Shop previews use the game's own mesh and materials. All icons are raster assets; no SVG or icon font is required.
